requires: mechanism-table.json passes=true before any native target is opened
proposalRule: Generate candidate ordinates with the existing CPU Hermite response against non-D native body levels. This surrogate proposes rows only; selection uses rendered WebGPU equal-cell mean body OKLab DeltaE and the unchanged 9x control cap.
sourceBaseline: Preserved G1d patch, no silhouette branch
mechanismBaseline: G1d response rows with silhouette branch

dark.middleRule: The measured pair is preferred; the intermediate and old pairs expose whether non-D controls refuse the measured middle knots.
dark.optimized: Third and far thin/thick ordinates; each remains in [0,1].

light.optimized: Middle and far ordinates for three knots, plus third ordinates for four knots; each remains in [0,1].
light.formRule: The three-knot form wins a rendered-objective tie; a fourth knot is retained only if it improves the fit objective while all controls hold.

proposalSearch.objective: Mean absolute cube-root level difference on fit cells, no controls; surrogate only
proposalSearch.noOtherFields: Accessibility levels, approximate refraction and every non-response facet remain unchanged.

selection.metric: Equal-cell mean body OKLab DeltaE, WebGPU, both scales
selection.stop: If the input check fails, no fit opens. If every candidate rung is refused by a control, stop rather than widening the family.
